import ctypes,json,os
from ctypes import wintypes

class FileId(ctypes.Structure):_fields_=[("volume",ctypes.c_ulonglong),("identifier",ctypes.c_ubyte*16)]
k=ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32",use_last_error=True)
k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.c_int,wintypes.LPVOID,wintypes.DWORD];k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx.restype=wintypes.BOOL
k.GetStdHandle.argtypes=[wintypes.DWORD];k.GetStdHandle.restype=wintypes.HANDLE
info=FileId()
try:
    ok=k.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(496,18,ctypes.byref(info),ctypes.sizeof(info));query_error=None
except OSError as e:
    ok=False;query_error=e.winerror
print(json.dumps({"pid":os.getpid(),"external_handle_file_id":str(info.volume)+":"+bytes(info.identifier).hex() if ok else None,"external_handle_query_error":query_error,"stdio_count":sum(bool(k.GetStdHandle(v)) for v in (0xfffffff6,0xfffffff5,0xfffffff4))}),flush=True)

import subprocess,sys,time,json,pathlib
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-I","-B","-c",'import subprocess,sys,time\np=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-I","-B","-c","import time;time.sleep(60)"])\nprint(p.pid,flush=True)\ntime.sleep(60)\n'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
grand=int(p.stdout.readline())
pathlib.Path("children-b7e61ecfd2714d489a150f5e04efe1b6.json").write_text(json.dumps([p.pid,grand]),encoding="ascii")
deadline=time.monotonic()+15
while not pathlib.Path("continue-b7e61ecfd2714d489a150f5e04efe1b6").exists():
    if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError("Host did not retain child handles")
    time.sleep(1/20)
print(json.dumps({"child_pid":p.pid,"grandchild_pid":grand}),flush=True)
